name: ClientSideServiceDiscovery
summary: Has the caller ask a service registry where the instances of a service are, and choose one itself, rather than being handed a fixed address.

roles.name: ClientSideServiceDiscovery
roles.summary: The participant that resolves locations and picks an instance. It holds the load balancing, the retry and the staleness — it may pick an instance the registry has not yet noticed is gone — and none of that is visible in the call it eventually makes.
